messages:
Lian Z.: Hey folks — PR #4280 updates several SDK examples and fixes some broken links in the migration guide. It's small but needs one prose reviewer and one code reviewer. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4280. Hoping to get this into the 09:00 PT merge window tomorrow.

Marco P.: I can do a quick prose pass. Noting we currently have a docs rotation gap tonight (nobody listed for after 6pm). If this misses the morning window it might sit until next rotation.

Judy F.: I'll take the code snippet review (JS + TS). Will run the snippet locally and check types. Also can swap flaky integration test for a mocked unit test if needed.

docs-ci-bot: Preview deployed: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-4280 (status: failing linkcheck: 1 404)

Lian Z.: The 404 is coming from /examples/old-auth.md referenced in migration/overview.md. I removed the link in the branch and pushed a fix.

Marco P.: Quick prose pass done. Left a tiny wording change about "session affinity" and added an inline note to clarify dedicated vs hosted behavior. Approving once Lian's link fix is in preview and CI passes.

Judy F.: Confirmed the JS snippet runs; swapped the integration test for a small mock and pushed. Also added a short comment about error shapes for reconnects. Approved.

Sam Y.: I'm on release duty tomorrow morning and can merge during the 09:00 PT merge window if CI is green and approvals are present. If you prefer morning merge, I'll handle backports for the patch release branch too.

docs-ci-bot: Preview deployed: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-4280 (status: passing)

Lian Z.: Thanks! Approving now.

Marco P.: Approved.

Sam Y.: All green — merging in the 09:00 PT slot and adding an entry to release-notes.md. Also created a small issue to cover the rotation gap for evening reviewers and suggested a "needs-review" label for link-only PRs so they surface.

Lian Z.: Appreciate it. I'll watch post-merge preview and follow up if any redirect or anchor issues show up. If anyone wants to add themselves to the evening rotation, please ping me or add to docs/OWNERSHIP.md.

Judy F.: Filing a tiny PR to add the "needs-linkcheck" label automation suggestion later today.

Marco P.: Thanks everyone — smooth handoff.
